# Safi

Safi pairs a near-black dark mode with a warm-paper light mode and a single clay accent used across links, buttons, toggles and checkboxes. Typography is Space Grotesk for headings, Inter for body text and JetBrains Mono for code, with hairline borders and one corner radius. The description states contrast compliant with WCAG AA.

![Safi screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abdulkader-safi/obsidian-safi-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)
